featured_reviews.name: Лилия
featured_reviews.review_text:
After receiving multiple advertisements for swimming classes at Michael Phelps, I enrolled my child in a trial class, eager to see if it would be a good fit for our family. However, after the trial class, I was informed that the school is fully booked and cannot accommodate my child in the regular sessions.

This experience has been frustrating and very misleading. It is disappointing to realize that despite the time and effort spent attending the trial class, there was no possibility of enrolling my child in your program due to the lack of available spots. This crucial information was not communicated to us beforehand, this should be clearly stated prior to booking trial classes.

Advertising trial classes when there are no available spots for regular enrollment is fraudulent and unprofessional. It creates false hopes and wastes valuable time for both parents and children.

I urge you to review this and ensure that clear and transparent communication is provided in the future. Prospective clients should be informed of the availability of spots before enrolling in any trial classes to avoid such disappointments.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Been here numerous times for swim meets and various events.

The 50M pool is very well maintained, clean and proper demarcation of lanes. Has a full 7 lanes with the 1st and 7th being extra wide.

Has a 5M diving board for diving facilities.

Clean and well kept wash amd changing rooms are provided.

Gets very crowded on weekends and holidays. Especially in the summer.

Coaching facilities are provided and has numerous staff on hand for any swimming and coaching requirements.

The canteen is a bit lacking in food and taste but does provide tea/coffee and light snacks.

Overall one of the best and well maintained pools in the suburbs and maintenance and cleanliness standards are very high.

featured_reviews.name: Shlok Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a life member of GSC for many years and overall it’s been a great place to be. The food quality is consistently good, and the gym is well-equipped with everything needed for a solid workout. The trainers and facilities are generally well maintained.

The club also offers excellent wellness amenities including steam, sauna, and other recreational facilities, which add a lot of value to the membership.

The only downside is that the gym can get quite crowded during peak hours. More importantly, health and hygiene standards in certain areas need to be taken more seriously. While the steam and sauna facilities are good, they sometimes have a lingering smell of oils and can feel a bit stuffy, especially when heavily used. More frequent cleaning, better ventilation, and closer attention to hygiene would significantly improve the overall experience.

That said, GSC continues to offer a strong overall experience, and as a life member, I feel it remains one of the better clubs in the city for fitness, dining, and family recreation.

featured_reviews.name: Kapil Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Positives:

Temperature-Controlled Pool – A big advantage, especially during rains and winter.
9-Foot Depth – Ideal for learning diving and improving treading water skills.
6-Day Availability – Open six days a week, making it easy to choose batches as per convenience.
Coaches – Highly professional, patient, courteous, dedicated, and knowledgeable.
All Swimming Strokes – Comprehensive training covering freestyle, breaststroke, backstroke, and butterfly.
Patient Learning Approach – Coaches ensure everyone learns at their own pace with proper attention.
Supportive Staff – Mouzam, Sakshi, and the entire administrative team are extremely helpful and cooperative.
All Age Groups Welcome – From kids as young as 5 to adults over 75, proving age is never a barrier.

My Journey:

I already knew breaststroke, but I always wanted to learn the other swimming styles. Like many, I never really found the time or push to start. When my wife joined the Michael Phelps Swimming program at Willingdon Sports Club, I would accompany her. One day, Mouzam encouraged me to join as well.

Initially, I was unsure—did I really need to learn new strokes? But I eventually decided to take the plunge, both literally and figuratively.

Starting out wasn’t easy. Learning new strokes felt challenging, but beginner coach Mahesh Sir played a key role in helping me pick up freestyle and backstroke. As I progressed, advanced coach Prayag Sir helped refine my breaststroke—I realized how much energy I had been wasting due to incorrect technique. He also guided me through learning butterfly, which is by far the most challenging stroke. Along the way, he fine-tuned all my strokes, especially backstroke and breaststroke.

Both coaches offered exceptional guidance, focusing on technique, form correction, drills, and personalized attention.

A special mention to Sameer Sir as well—though I had limited sessions with him, his professionalism and dedication stood out.

Even with prior knowledge of basic swimming, it took me nearly a year to confidently learn all strokes. The coaches and staff are incredibly friendly and always ready to help with any concerns.

A big thank you to Mahesh Sir, Prayag Sir, and Mouzam for their consistent support and dedication.

Final Thought:
The facility and coaching are excellent—but consistency is the key to truly learning and improving in swimming.

featured_reviews.name: PJ BP
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable experience.

I was passed between multiple physiotherapists who gave completely inconsistent advice, sometimes directly contradicting each other. There was no continuity of care, no coherent plan, and no sense that anyone actually knew or cared what the other had told me.

They push you into buying a 12 session package upfront, creating the impression that you will be properly guided through recovery. That turned out to be completely misleading. On my final session, instead of giving me a clear plan for what to do next, I was told I would have to pay another ₹3000 just to be told how to continue. That is not care. That is a deliberate upsell at the last possible moment.

The quality of the sessions themselves was underwhelming. The physiotherapist I saw most often did not address my main issue, which I had clearly raised in the very first ₹3000 session, until I brought it up again myself. Basic attention to the patient’s stated problem was missing.

They also push expensive aqua sessions regardless of whether they are necessary. Everything feels structured around extracting as much money as possible rather than providing appropriate treatment.

What happened at the end was even worse. I was told I had already been given exercise videos. I had not. This was either carelessness or confusion with another patient, and there was no effort to fix it.

When I asked for my own treatment notes and progress details, I was refused on the basis that they were “confidential.” That makes no sense. I am the patient. Refusing to provide my own records is completely unacceptable.

Instead, I was promised a report. Of course, that was never sent either.

This entire experience felt disorganized, inconsistent, and driven by money rather than patient care. I would strongly recommend going elsewhere.

Title: A Refreshing Oasis in the Heart of Mumbai

As a resident of Mahim, I've been frequenting the Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool for many years, and I've always been impressed by its facilities and the overall swimming experience it offers. While there's always room for improvement, I believe the pool deserves a solid 4-star rating, reflecting its strengths and acknowledging the areas where it could enhance its offerings.

Cleanliness and Maintenance:

The pool complex is generally well-maintained, with clean and hygienic pools, changing rooms, and shower areas. The staff regularly checks the water quality, ensuring it meets the necessary standards. While there have been instances of minor cleanliness issues, they've been promptly addressed by the staff.

Facilities and Amenities:

The pool complex boasts a variety of amenities catering to swimmers of all ages and skill levels. The main pool, an Olympic-sized one, is ideal for lap swimming and training. The separate diving pool is perfect for practicing dives and aquatic stunts. Additionally, there's a smaller pool for kids, providing a safe and fun environment for them to learn and enjoy the water.

Pool Staff and Safety:

The pool staff is generally helpful and attentive, ensuring the safety of swimmers at all times. Experienced lifeguards are stationed around the pools, keeping a watchful eye on everyone. The pool also has clear signage and safety guidelines in place to minimize the risk of accidents.

Overall Experience:

Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool is a great place to come for a refreshing swim, whether you're looking for a leisurely workout or a fun family outing. The pool's facilities are well-maintained, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the safety measures are commendable. While there's always room for improvement, the pool consistently delivers a positive swimming experience, earning it a solid 4-star rating.

Areas for Improvement:

Parking: The pool's parking facilities can be limited during peak hours, making it challenging to find a spot. Expanding the parking area or introducing valet parking services would be beneficial.

Shower Rooms: The shower rooms could be refurbished to provide a more modern and comfortable experience. Upgrading the fixtures and adding more shower cubicles would enhance the overall experience.

Food Options: While there are a few snack and beverage options available at the canteen it closes by 9 pm and expanding the food menu to include more substantial meals would cater to swimmers who spend longer hours at the pool.

Despite these areas for improvement, Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool remains a valuable asset to the Dadar community and a popular choice for both casual swimmers and fitness enthusiasts. Its dedication to cleanliness, safety, and providing a welcoming environment makes it a rewarding place to spend a day in the water.

Visited a few times here for dinners & lunches now and had an amazing experience both the times.

featured_reviews.name: aditi mane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have visited Wadala Sports Club multiple times, either for bookings or to enquire about facilities. Unfortunately, the experience has been consistently disappointing because of the rude and unprofessional behaviour of the receptionist and some staff members who seevrely lack professionalism and customer retention.

On one occasion some 3-4 months back during heavy rains, I was left stranded at the entrance with my car because the parking gate was shut and no watchman was present. There was another car parked blocking the entrace of the parking and there was no way to park the car near the gate as it would have caused nuisance to others. we opened the gate ourselves but struggled with where to park the car. Despite clearly seeing the situation stading on the main door of the club, the receptionist refused to offer any assistance or even call someone to guide us. Instead, I had to leave my car outside and then walk in the rain to enter the club, and ended up drenched while entering the club for an event. Later, I saw the same receptionist casually sitting with the watchman he had claimed was unavailable.

On another occasion, when I visited with a friend to enquire about the club’s sports activities and fees, his attitude was dismissive. He simply told us to “read the circular” and refused to answer any questions, even when we had doubts after reading the notice. Instead of being welcoming and helpful, he was curt and arrogant — an attitude unbecoming of the first point of contact for a members’ club.

The club facilities may be good, but this kind of customer-facing behaviour reflects very poorly on the institution. Members and visitors expect courtesy, guidance, and respect, not indifference and attitude.

Unless the management takes steps to train or replace such staff, I cant whole heartedly recommend Wadala Sports Club.

featured_reviews.name: anL
featured_reviews.review_text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but after months of seeing the same problems and hearing the same complaints from other members, I feel this needs to be said.

The condition of this pool is simply unacceptable. Almost every time I visit, there are visible particles, bugs, slimy debris, and other contaminants floating in the water. The pool frequently looks dirty, and the filtration system rarely appears to be running. On one recent visit, the water was so dirty that I swam for barely two minutes before getting out and calling staff to inspect it. Instead of acknowledging the issue, I was told the pool was clean while visible debris remained in the water.

The area around the pool is no better. Rats, pigeons, and large insects are commonly seen around the facility, and there have been occasions where what appeared to be rat droppings were present near one of the staircases. For any swimming facility, this should be treated as a serious hygiene issue, not something that is repeatedly ignored.

The washrooms are honestly shocking. They often have a very strong smell, zero ventilation, and become unbearably hot. There is not even a fan in the bathroom area, making it feel like a sauna. The shower water pressure is so weak that it is barely usable. When concerns about the smell were raised, the response was essentially that it was “mostly the men’s washroom,” which completely misses the point. Members should not have to deal with that in the first place.

Maintenance across the facility appears to be severely neglected. Multiple tiles under the pool are cracked, the handrail used to enter the pool shakes and feels loose, and other damaged handrails seem to stay broken for months without repair. These are basic safety issues that should have been addressed long ago.

Another incident that I found highly unprofessional involved a female staff member sitting in the shower area wrapped only in a towel and appearing ready to use the same shower facilities as members. Regardless of the circumstances, this reflected poorly on the professionalism and management of the facility.

What is most frustrating is that these problems are not new. Virtually every regular member I have spoken to has complained about the same issues. The standard response is always “we’ll check” or “we’ll look into it,” yet nothing ever seems to change. Members are even told to come at different times if the pool is dirty, which is unreasonable. If the facility opens at 7:00 AM, the pool should be clean and ready to use at 7:00 AM—not hours later.

There is also often no visible attendant, maintenance staff member, or lifeguard around the pool area. For a facility charging members and operating a swimming pool, the lack of supervision is concerning.

At this point, the issue is not a dirty day or a one-off maintenance problem. It is a pattern of poor cleanliness, poor upkeep, and a management team that seems far more interested in dismissing complaints than fixing them. This facility has potential, but potential means very little when the same problems continue month after month despite repeated complaints from members.

There are far better-maintained pools in the area that take cleanliness, safety, and member concerns seriously. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this facility.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Venkat
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have to say, my visit to C'est La Vie on Hill Road, Bandra, through my Fitpass membership was nothing short of a nightmare. This place is an absolute disgrace. From the shady, dilapidated entrance to the gym’s basement location, everything screams neglect. The gym equipment is ancient, rusted, and downright dangerous. It feels like a health hazard rather than a place to work out. The dumbbells are corroded, many machines are out of order, and the whole place has a creepy, unkempt vibe.

The state of the bathrooms is appalling—they smell like a filthy public restroom and are in desperate need of cleaning and maintenance. The mirrors are stained, the floors are grimy, and the entire facility looks like it hasn’t seen a renovation since the early 2000s.

To make matters worse, the annual membership fee of 40,000 INR is a complete rip-off for such a shoddy, outdated facility. There are plenty of better, more modern gyms in the area at a fraction of the cost.

This place is a total scam and a health risk. Save your money and avoid this gym at all costs. I hope the management takes this feedback as constructive criticism and considers renovating the gym to improve the equipment and overall environment.

Over the decades, it has become a hub for a wide range of indoor and outdoor sports. The club offers excellent facilities for games like table tennis, billiards, cards, tennis, cricket, and swimming. In addition to the sports, Khar Gymkhana also boasts a popular restaurant called The Pavilion, known for its diverse menu of  food and drinks.

Membership to Khar Gymkhana is exclusive, with life membership available to individuals either within the immediate family or those married into a family that holds membership. There are also other types of memberships that can be obtained.

During our visit, we enjoyed a nice lunch and had time to observe some of the ongoing activities and games around the club. The food was delicious, and the service was surprisingly fast, considering the large crowd the restaurant was catering to. From the starters to the desserts, everything—whether vegetarian or non-vegetarian—was prepared well. However, there was one issue: the club lacked sufficient wheelchairs. A senior citizen in our group had to wait for a while to get access to one, as it was already in use by another member.

pure sports club without the oomph of other' clubs in South Mumbai, you shall be lucky to have a dad who bought you this memberships. Views to die for. Last and least and upgraded childrens garden to int'l style. Lil Types

An Elite Club Of Members Promoted By the Erstwhile Textile Family Barons, Mafatlal Group, for only Hindu's, 90 % crowd belongs to the Gujarati, Maradwadi, Maharashtrians a typical Ghettos. Few firsts by the club, has a Olympic Sized Swimming pool and city's major competitive events are still held here. Should be only club to have a Boat Club, kinda of a private beach enterance to a lagoon kinda sea waters. Probably the only club which would have a full different pool for the females. Maintaining 2 full-sized pools just for 2 genders is high maintenance affair. Hi-tech Gym equipments. Latest Kids Garden. A decent TV room wherein 100+ plus members seat (to watch, without food being served) all sporting events live on the 100' in screen, a great family feeling. featured_reviews.review_text:
The history of this club is interesting, but its current policy is total nonsense. This club is strictly meant only for life members and their descendants. While I personally have no involvement with this, they should at least mention this crucial fact on their website.
​I recently moved from Sion to Tardeo, and after searching online, I visited this club today as it was the nearest swimming pool. However, the watchman informed me that membership is strictly hereditary, intended only for blood relatives. He also stated that no new memberships have been granted since 1995.
​This situation is truly disgusting because they fail to mention this restriction online. I assume that countless people must have visited over the years, only to leave disappointed. This current owner/s' mentality is extremely poor—it's a form of harassment for non-members, perhaps seeking publicity or some perverse pleasure.
​If that is not the case, they must immediately update their website with this fact. Doing so would prevent the wastage of time and harassment of non-members.
